notes:
PocketScanTCG now focuses on card identification and condition/grade estimation.

- Removed the counterfeit-screening and graded-slab flows, the raw-card analysis tests (rosette, print texture, light transmission, edge/core, dimensions, weight and visual hand-feel), the calibration lab and its contribution panel, and the screening band/disposition model.
- The upgrade drops saved screening and slab records from local storage; saved condition checks are kept.
- Home, History, Guide and Settings now cover only Identify and Condition.
- Removed the slab barcode scanner and its Android activity, and dropped the unused raw capture modes from the native guide overlay.

Debug build of the PocketScanTCG Android app (debug-signed). Sideload for testing.
